## 1. root-discord Gradle module

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Module path | `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Plugin Building\Minecraft\plugins\root-discord` |
| Gradle id | `:plugins:root-discord` (auto-included via `settings.gradle.kts`) |
| Gradle version | `1.7.14` (`build.gradle.kts`) |
| Bukkit `name` | `Root-Discord` |
| Bukkit `version` | `${version}` → `1.7.14` at build |
| `main` | `com.rootrecord.minecraft.rootdiscord.RootDiscordPlugin` |
| Package (plugin) | `com.rootrecord.minecraft.rootdiscord` |
| Shared API package | `com.rootrecord.minecraft.common` (`RootDiscordApi`, `RootDiscordSupport`) |
| Hard `depend` | `[Root-Core]` |
| Command / perm | `/rootdiscord`, `rootdiscord.admin` |
| Source files (excl. build) | 9 (5 Java + `plugin.yml` + `root-discord.yml` + `README.md` + `build.gradle.kts`) |
| Handoff jars | `root-discord-1.7.14.jar` on Claims / Towny / Test |
| Manifest (web) | still `1.7.13` in `Web Files\rootmc-web\public\plugins\manifest.json` |
| GitHub staging | `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\github-plugin-repos\staging\root-discord\` |

---

## 2. What it does

Per-server Paper Discord bot (one JDA session): MC↔Discord chat, reachout posts, server-log uploads (Slack preferred, Discord channel fallback).

**Key classes** (`...\root-discord\src\main\java\com\rootrecord\minecraft\rootdiscord\`):

| Class | Role |
|---|---|
| `RootDiscordPlugin` | Enable/disable, register `RootDiscordApi`, `/rootdiscord status\|reload` |
| `RootDiscordApiImpl` | Implements common `RootDiscordApi` |
| `DiscordChatConfig` | Reads `root-discord.yml` + `cloud.yml` (+ legacy `rootmc.yml` `discord-chat.*`) |
| `DiscordChatBridge` | JDA session, chat/join/leave/death/reachout, Discord log upload |
| `SlackServerLogsClient` | Incoming Webhook posts to Slack `#server-logs` |

**Common bridge** (`...\rootrecord-common\...`):

- `RootDiscordApi` — `isReady`, `postChatLine`, `postReachout`, `uploadServerLog`, `reload`
- `RootDiscordSupport.PLUGIN_NAME = "Root-Discord"`
- `ShadedServiceBridge.resolveDiscord(...)`
- `RootMcDiscordConfig` — resolves `cloud.yml` `discord.*` / legacy `discord-chat.*`
- `RootRecordFolders.ROOT_DISCORD_CONFIG = "root-discord.yml"`

**Config files:**

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `plugins/RootMC/cloud.yml` | Secrets + channel IDs (`discord.*`, `slack.*`) |
| `plugins/RootMC/root-discord.yml` | Chat flags (template in module; **not present on handoffs yet** — created on first boot) |
| `plugins/RootMC/rootmc.yml` → `discord-chat.*` | Legacy fallback if `root-discord.yml` `chat` empty |

**Runtime deps:** `compileOnly(:plugins:root-core)`; shades JDA `6.4.2`; **excludes** `com/rootrecord/minecraft/common/**` so Core’s shaded common is used at runtime.

**Consumers of the API:**

- `rootmc` — `PublicReachoutService`, `RootDiscordSupport.warnIfMissing`
- `rootmc-official` — `OfficialHourlyLogRelay` (hourly JUL → Discord/Slack via API)

---

## 3. root-core already exists — yes

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Path | `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Plugin Building\Minecraft\plugins\root-core` |
| Bukkit name | `Root-Core` |
| Version | `1.7.5` |
| Main | `com.rootrecord.minecraft.rootcore.RootCorePlugin` |
| Package | `com.rootrecord.minecraft.rootcore` (+ `api`, `cloud`, `command`, `license`, `suite`, `transfer`, `update`, `config`) |

**Role:** suite spine — shared `plugins/RootMC/` unit (`database.yml`, `cloud.yml`, `root-core.yml`, `license.yml`), license bind/presence, `RootCoreApi`, suite updater, `/goto` transfer mesh, `/rootcore`. **Does not own JDA**; docs point Discord to Root-Discord. `loadbefore` includes `Root-Discord`. `SuiteSpine` recommended pack `"Discord" → ["Root-Discord"]`.

Separate: `scripts\root-core-node\` (Windows helper) and `Change Logs\plugins\root-core.md` — not the Paper Discord plugin.

---

## 4. How others depend on root-discord

| Kind | Who | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Hard `depend` | root-discord → Root-Core | `plugin.yml` `depend: [Root-Core]` |
| Soft `softdepend` | `RootMC`, `RootMC-Official` | `softdepend: [..., Root-Discord]` |
| `loadbefore` | Root-Core → Root-Discord | Core loads first |
| `compileOnly(:plugins:root-discord)` | **None** | No Gradle compile dep on root-discord |
| Runtime / API | rootmc, rootmc-official | Via `rootrecord-common` `RootDiscordApi` / `ShadedServiceBridge.resolveDiscord`; features drop if jar missing |
| compileOnly root-core | Many suite plugins | Unrelated to Discord; Core is the license/DB spine |

---

## 5. Handoff `cloud.yml` / RootMC config keys (discord/slack)

No `RootMC.yml`. Shared folder is `plugins\RootMC\` with `cloud.yml`, `rootmc.yml`, etc.

**`cloud.yml` keys (template + Claims/Towny/Test handoffs):**

```
cloud.api-base
cloud.server-id
cloud.server-secret

discord.bot-token
discord.guild-id
discord.channels.ingame-chat
discord.channels.server-logs
discord.roles.linked

slack.server-logs-channel
slack.server-logs-webhook
# also read: slack.webhooks.server-logs
# also env/prop: SLACK_SERVER_LOGS_WEBHOOK_URL / rootmc.slack.server-logs-webhook

# legacy aliases:
discord-chat.bot-token
discord-chat.guild-id
discord-chat.channel-id
```

**`root-discord.yml` keys:**

```
chat.enabled
chat.server-tag
chat.allowed-role-id
chat.relay-chat | relay-join | relay-leave | relay-death | relay-reachout
chat.inbound-format
```

**Legacy `rootmc.yml` `discord-chat.*`:** same chat keys as above (fallback).

**`rootmc-official.yml`:**

```
server-log-sync.enabled
server-log-sync.channel-id
server-log-sync.interval-minutes
server-log-sync.server-tag
```

**`root-core.yml`:** no Discord/Slack keys (public cloud/license/updater only).

Setup script touching handoff `cloud.yml` slack keys: `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\scripts\setup-slack-server-logs.ps1`

---

## 6. Rename / merge surface area

**Do not merge Discord into Root-Core without a large redesign** — Core is license/cloud/updater; Discord is JDA + Slack uploads + soft API. Prefer rename-in-place of the `root-discord` module if rebranding.

| Layer | Approx. files | Identifiers to touch |
|---|---|---|
| Plugin module | ~9 source | folder `root-discord`, package `rootdiscord`, classes `RootDiscord*`, `plugin.yml` name/command/perm, jar name |
| Common API | 4 Java | `RootDiscordApi`, `RootDiscordSupport`, `ROOT_DISCORD_CONFIG`, `PLUGIN_NAME` |
| Consumers | ~6 | softdepend strings, warn/log text, `resolveDiscord` call sites |
| Core refs | 2–3 | `loadbefore: Root-Discord`, `SuiteSpine` pack, README |
| Web docs/manifest | ~6 | `/plugins/root-discord/`, `manifest.json` key `root-discord`, wiki HTML |
| GitHub staging + REPO-INDEX | ~20 | mirror of above |
| Workspace-wide name hits | **~60 files** (excl. build/logs/agent-transcripts) | string `Root-Discord` / `root-discord` / `RootDiscord` / `rootdiscord` |

**Config keys — usually keep (product Discord/Slack, not plugin id):**  
`discord.*`, `slack.*`, `discord-chat.*`, `server-log-sync.*`

**Config / Bukkit keys that rename with the plugin:**  
`root-discord.yml` filename, `RootRecordFolders.ROOT_DISCORD_CONFIG`, Bukkit name `Root-Discord`, command `rootdiscord`, perm `rootdiscord.admin`, artifact/module/manifest id `root-discord`

**If merging into Root-Core:** also move JDA shade, `SlackServerLogsClient`, bridge listeners, `/rootdiscord` → Core command surface, flip RootMC/Official softdepend, and decide whether `RootDiscordApi` stays or becomes `RootCoreApi` methods — higher blast radius than rename.

---

## 7. Changelog / rebrand docs

**No dedicated rebrand/rename/merge doc found** for root-discord.

Existing mentions only:

- `github-plugin-repos\staging\root-discord\CHANGELOG.md` — publish note for `1.7.13` only
- Module `README.md`, wiki `network-setup`, `plugins/root-discord/index.html`, `root-core` README Discord section
- `Change Logs\build-root-discord-slack.log` — build stub, not product changelog
- `Change Logs\plugins\` — **no** `root-discord.md`
- No “rebrand Root-Discord” hits under `Plugin Building\Minecraft\docs` or `GEN-1-GEN-2.md`
